title: Local vanishing for F-pure threefolds
summary: We establish Grauert--Riemenschneider vanishing for $F$-pure threefolds over a perfect field $k$ of characteristic $p>5$. We apply this to prove Steenbrink vanishing for three-dimensional sharply $F$-pure pairs in characteristic $p>5$. As a consequence, we obtain the logarithmic extension for one-forms in this setting.
